_about: Video rules for the PM agent. Change a number or a text here to retrain it; no code change and no restart needed. The agent only reads and reports - it never restarts, stops or changes anything.

tracker_stale.cause: The Video Coverage tracker runs in MES-API's background worker and has stopped updating.
tracker_stale.action: Check MES-API for 'THE background leader'; restart MES-API by hand only with approval.

tracker_error.cause: The Video Coverage tracker reported an error on its last pass.
tracker_error.action: Read the error text; check the MES-API log for [VCOV].

cms_down.cause: The CMS (:5555) is not answering, so no camera is recording.
cms_down.action: Check the CMS; restart it by hand (CMS_QUIET_SECONDS=90) only with approval.

segment_down.cause: Every camera on this network segment stopped answering ping: switch, gateway or power, not MES.
segment_down.action: Ask the network team to check the switch and gateway for this segment.

camera_offline.cause: The camera does not answer ping: power, cable or switch port.
camera_offline.action: Check camera power and cable at the machine.

camera_hung.cause: The camera answers ping but sends no video, usually a hung stream after a reconnect.

camera_wrong_ip.cause: The camera is bound to an IP that belongs to a PLC, so no video can come from it.
camera_wrong_ip.action: Correct the camera IP in Camera Master.

recorder_duplicate.cause: Two recorders are writing the same camera; a single-session camera then drops one.
recorder_duplicate.action: Check the CMS recorders for this camera.

recorder_stuck.cause: The recorder is running but its footage file has stopped growing.
recorder_stuck.action: Check the camera stream on the Video Coverage page.

recorder_deleted_file.cause: A recorder is writing to a file that was already deleted, so its footage is lost.
recorder_deleted_file.action: Leftover recorder from an earlier CMS run; needs a manual CMS clean-up.

archiver_capacity.cause: Cameras recorded the cycles but the clip archiver could not cut them in time.
archiver_capacity.action: Capacity issue, covered by the 48-hour footage and zone archiver plan.

fi_no_camera.cause: No camera is assigned to this Final Inspection machine.
fi_no_camera.action: Assign a camera if video is needed, otherwise mute this item.

no_camera_machines.cause: These machines produce cycles but have no camera assigned.
no_camera_machines.action: Assign cameras where video is needed, otherwise mute this item.

zone_low.cause: Sub-machine clip coverage is clearly below this zone's normal level.
zone_low.action: Check the zone's cameras and the archiver on the Video Coverage page.

zone_no_clips.cause: Machines in this zone produce cycles but no clips are being cut.
zone_no_clips.action: Check the zone's cameras on the Video Coverage page.

shift_change_loss.cause: Cameras dropped at the shift change: the CMS restarts every recorder at each shift start and single-session cameras can hang.
shift_change_loss.action: Check the cameras on the Video Coverage page; power-cycle any that stay hung.

disk_low.cause: The video disk is running out of space.
disk_low.action: Free space or shorten retention (decision needed).

_mute_help: To silence a known item, add {"id": "<gap id or prefix>", "until": "YYYY-MM-DD", "note": "why"}. It stays visible as muted but sends no alerts. Example ids: video:cam:<camera_id>, video:nocam, video:fi:<line_id>.
